title: LGNO: A Local-Global Neural Operator for Hyperbolic Conservation Laws
summary: Solutions of hyperbolic conservation laws exhibit both smooth structures across large scales and sharp localized features such as shocks and contact discontinuities, making them difficult to approximate accurately with existing neural operators. The Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) captures long-range interactions well but tends to smear localized structures through excessive numerical dissipation.
